skill.summary: 社区团购营销与促销全链路技能包。涵盖活动策划、爆品打造、优惠券体系、各平台营销策略对比及配套工具。适用于平台运营、营销负责人。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the community group buying marketing & promotion skill pack:

- Covers full-chain marketing and promotion for community group buying: activity planning, bestseller creation, coupon system, marketing strategy comparisons across platforms, and supporting tools.
- Provides clear boundaries and modular structure; focuses only on "how to sell" (marketing & promotion), referencing other modules for product selection, customer acquisition/retention, group leader management, supply chain, and logistics.
- Offers detailed SOPs (standard operating procedures) for product promotion, large-scale promotion planning, and emergency oversell handling.
- Includes comprehensive matrices for promotion activity types, coupon system design, and annual/weekly promotion calendars.
- Compares marketing strategies and subsidy models of major platforms (Meituan, Pinduoduo, Xingsheng, Taocaicai).
- Designed for platform operations and marketing managers.
